description:
Docker-based local PHP+Node.js web development environments


## Installation

See the [installation instructions](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/install/ddev-installation/) for details, but it's easy:

• macOS：`brew install ddev/ddev/ddev` or just `brew upgrade ddev`.
• Linux：Use `sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install ddev`, see [apt/yum installation](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/install/ddev-installation/#linux)
• Windows and WSL2：Download the [Windows Installer](https://ddev.com/download/); you can run it for install or upgrade.
• Consider `ddev delete images` or `ddev delete images --all` after upgrading to free up disk space used by previous Docker image versions. This does no harm.
• Consider `ddev config --auto` to update your projects to current configuration.

## Highlights

Blog announcement：https://ddev.com/blog/release-v1-25-6/

• **[PHP 8.6.0](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#php_version)**, the final release, replacing 8.6.0 RC3. apcu, imagick, memcached, redis, uploadprogress, xdebug, xhprof, xmlrpc, and yaml are not available for 8.6 yet
• **PHP security releases** 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37, and 8.2.36, see below

## PHP Security Fixes

• PHP 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37, and 8.2.36 fix the [17 advisories](https://github.com/php/php-src/security/advisories) published on November 19. deb.sury.org backported the same fixes to PHP 5.6 through 8.1, keeping their version numbers. DDEV installs them when it builds the project's web image
• None looks urgent for a default DDEV project. DDEV's settings already block two of the critical ones (`session.upload_progress.enabled = 0` and `zend.exception_ignore_args = On`), and its setup avoids the PHP-FPM ones. A custom config, like a file-based `error_log` or `fastcgi_keep_conn on`, can open some of them again
• For future PHP releases, the tip in [`php_version`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/config/#php_version) shows how to get a patch release before DDEV ships it

## ⚠️ Breaking Changes

• `web` and `db` no longer mount the shared `ddev-global-cache` volume. Add-ons that write to `/mnt/ddev-global-cache` from `web`, like ddev-nvm and ddev-pnpm, lose that data on restart until they mount it themselves, see [The `ddev-global-cache` Volume](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/architecture/#the-ddev-global-cache-volume)
• Each project has its own [cache volumes](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/architecture/#project-cache-volumes). After upgrading, bash and MySQL history start empty, and the first Composer or npm install downloads everything again
• nginx now denies what the CMS's `.htaccess` denies on Apache, such as Drupal `*.yml` and `*.twig` files, and Apache denies dotfiles. If you removed `#ddev-generated` from [`.ddev/nginx_full/nginx-site.conf`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customization-extendibility/#custom-nginx-configuration) or [`.ddev/apache/apache-site.conf`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customization-extendibility/#custom-apache-configuration), merge the changes from the new template
• The table output of `ddev list`, `ddev describe`, and `ddev snapshot --list` changed. Scripts should use `-j`
• Scripts that pipe answers into bare `ddev config` need a leading `no` line

## Features

• Interactive [`ddev config`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#config) shows the detected configuration in a form, where you can change the PHP version, database, and webserver before accepting it
• [`ddev list`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#list), [`ddev describe`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#describe), and [`ddev snapshot --list`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#snapshot) fit the terminal width and match [`ddev tui`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/commands/#tui)
• `CI` from the host is [passed into the `web` container](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/configuration/environment-variables/#ci-from-the-host)
• The [Wagtail quickstart](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/quickstart/#wagtail) builds its virtual environment in the web image, see [Python Packages from `requirements.txt`](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/customizing-images/#python-packages-from-requirementstxt)
• `ddev start` warns when Docker Desktop on macOS resets connections to router ports

## Bug Fixes for Regressions

• Usage data is sent again when you [opted in](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/diagnostics/). v1.25.5 sent nothing
• Lines typed after a command that reads the terminal, like the Craft CMS setup wizard, are no longer dropped. This broke in v1.25.3

## Bug Fixes

• Global commands no longer go missing or come from another global config directory
• A restarted `web` or `xhgui` container no longer takes about 60 seconds to become healthy
• Commands that run at the same time no longer drop each other's projects from `project_list.yaml`, and `omit_project_name_by_default` no longer registers a project with an empty name
• [Custom command](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/extend/custom-commands/) files keep their group-write bit and ACLs, thanks to @steffenmaechtel
• A renamed project no longer causes "Router configuration errors"
• On Windows, `ddev pull` no longer fails with `Unknown command '\U'`, and WordPress and Backdrop no longer get a `.gitignore` in the project root
• A substitute port used because the configured one was busy is no longer written into `.ddev/config.yaml`, and neither is a port from the global configuration
• Let's Encrypt no longer stops silently when `acme.json` permissions change
• XHGui imports profiles up to 100MB, not 5MB
• Ctrl-C no longer leaves temporary containers behind when Docker is slow
• `ddev start` with Mutagen retries after two intermittent Mutagen races
• `ddev composer create-project` no longer hangs on an open stdin pipe, no longer shows stray `tate=working:app=composer` text with Composer 2.11, and passes piped answers to Composer scripts in order
• With Podman and Mutagen, the image's default `index.html` is no longer synced into new projects

## Security Changes

• A crafted archive in `ddev add-on get`, `ddev import-db`, or `ddev import-files` can no longer write outside the destination through relative symlinks, see [GHSA-vxj4-5gfg-97c2](https://github.com/ddev/ddev/security/advisories/GHSA-vxj4-5gfg-97c2)
• nginx deny rules now come before the PHP location, so PHP files in denied directories (TYPO3 `vendor`, CodeIgniter `system`, hidden directories) no longer run, thanks to @Atesca
• The `ddev-xhgui` image gets current Alpine packages instead of PHP 8.3.23 and nginx 1.28.0 from July 2025

## Internal Changes

• Work toward Apple Container support ([#7372](https://github.com/ddev/ddev/issues/7372), [#8895](https://github.com/ddev/ddev/issues/8895))：no DDEV volume is mounted read-write by two containers
• [Opt-in usage data](https://docs.ddev.com/en/stable/users/usage/diagnostics/) is sent as weekly summaries instead of an event for every command. Nothing is sent unless you opted in

## Minor Updates

• PHP 8.6.0, 8.5.13, 8.4.28, 8.3.37, and 8.2.36
• PHP 8.6 uses PHP's default `fatal_error_backtraces` again
• Docker Compose v5.8.0, recommended buildx 0.39.0
• `--help` shows `[=true|false]` after boolean flags, and the error for an invalid flag value is worded differently (pflag v1.1.0)
